gen-audiowide-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Audiowide draws every curve with the same flat line, each glyph sitting in its own wide tile of space. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a plain sans, keeps that steady weight over a long read, with generous entrances into its curves.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-north-arabian: Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase with outward-pointing terminals, friendly and uncomplicated in tone. Eater earns its keep big and short, where its thin strokes can show.
gen-almendra-display-gf-sono: Sono spaces its tall lowercase widely, with every a left ajar. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary flourish above, so give it a generous size and let the body stay modest.
gen-audiowide-gf-stack-sans-headline: Audiowide's strokes never thicken or thin, and its glyphs sit like tiles separated by wide grout lines. Stack Sans Headline is the one for small text, crisp and deep-bodied.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Noto Sans Old Permic has rounded forms that stay clearly open, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. But Eater does its best work as a dark, aggressive headline, while the body handles the steady reading.
gen-audiowide-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads sturdy and bulky, its marker-like line leaving distinct gaps in c, e, s and a. Sulphur Point against Audiowide's tiled, futuristic glyphs is the pair's real draw: one loud and spaced out, one dense and sensible.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-lao-lo: Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks, its bowls left unfinished on one side. And Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary voice with a pronounced x-height that never pinches shut.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Noto Sans Old Persian stands tall and clean, its counters breathing into the white space. Eater sits above with a dark, aggressive edge, its thin strokes like thread against yarn, while the body keeps the page open and contemporary.
gen-audiowide-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans rises nearly to cap height, with a spacious opening on the c. Audiowide's single-width trail, like a rolling-ball pen, gives that modern sans-serif a futuristic partner with real attitude.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Eater brings dark, aggressive color with hairlines only slightly lighter than its stems. Noto Sans Old Sogdian is the quality worth noting: a tall x-height and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk.
